device_role_states.name: Bus Controller (BC)
device_role_states.description: Active master of the bus this cycle. Issues Command Words, schedules transfers, receives Status Words, and decides retry policy. Exactly one BC active per bus at any time.

device_role_states.name: Backup Bus Controller (BBC)
device_role_states.description: Standby BC. Becomes active via Dynamic Bus Control mode-code handoff or via discrete failover line + bus-quiescent detection.

device_role_states.name: Remote Terminal (RT)
device_role_states.description: Slave / responder. Decodes each Command Word; if addressed and able, responds with Status Word (+ Data Words) within 4-12 µs.

device_role_states.name: Bus Monitor (BM)
device_role_states.description: Passive listener. Records every word for telemetry / off-line analysis. SHALL NOT transmit on the bus.

fsm_hints_bus_controller.name: BC_IDLE
fsm_hints_bus_controller.description: Bus quiescent (no message in flight). BC selects next message from its schedule (cyclic-executive or acyclic).

fsm_hints_bus_controller.name: BC_SELECT_BUS
fsm_hints_bus_controller.description: BC chooses Bus A or Bus B for this message; redundancy is per-message.

fsm_hints_bus_controller.name: BC_TX_COMMAND
fsm_hints_bus_controller.description: BC transmits Command Word (3 µs Command/Status sync + 16 bits + odd parity).

fsm_hints_bus_controller.name: BC_TX_DATA
fsm_hints_bus_controller.description: (BC→RT message only) BC transmits 1..32 Data Words back-to-back (each 3 µs Data sync + 16 bits + parity), then transitions to wait-for-status.

fsm_hints_bus_controller.name: BC_WAIT_RT_RESPONSE
fsm_hints_bus_controller.description: BC waits 4-12 µs for the addressed RT's Status Word; after 14 µs of bus quiet, declares no-response.

fsm_hints_bus_controller.name: BC_RX_STATUS
fsm_hints_bus_controller.description: BC receives and validates Status Word; checks RT-address echo + MESSAGE ERROR + BUSY + SERVICE REQUEST + BROADCAST COMMAND RECEIVED + SUBSYSTEM FLAG + DYNAMIC BUS ACCEPTANCE + TERMINAL FLAG.

fsm_hints_bus_controller.name: BC_RX_DATA
fsm_hints_bus_controller.description: (RT→BC message only) BC receives 1..32 Data Words from the RT immediately after the RT's Status Word.

fsm_hints_bus_controller.name: BC_GAP
fsm_hints_bus_controller.description: BC enforces ≥ 4 µs inter-message gap before launching the next Command Word.

fsm_hints_bus_controller.name: BC_RETRY
fsm_hints_bus_controller.description: On no-response or error Status, BC retries on the same bus or immediately on the redundant bus per retry policy.

fsm_hints_remote_terminal.name: RT_IDLE
fsm_hints_remote_terminal.description: Bus quiet. RT continuously samples the bus for a Command/Status sync field.

fsm_hints_remote_terminal.name: RT_RX_COMMAND
fsm_hints_remote_terminal.description: RT decodes Command Word; checks Manchester encoding + odd parity + sync polarity + RT-address match (or broadcast).

fsm_hints_remote_terminal.name: RT_DECODE
fsm_hints_remote_terminal.description: RT classifies the command: receive-data, transmit-data, mode-without-data, mode-with-data. Subaddress 0/31 routes to Mode Code path.

fsm_hints_remote_terminal.name: RT_RX_DATA
fsm_hints_remote_terminal.description: (receive-message only) RT receives the BC's Data Words (count = Word Count field), buffering each into the addressed subaddress data buffer.

fsm_hints_remote_terminal.name: RT_RESPONSE_GAP
fsm_hints_remote_terminal.description: RT waits the response delay (≥ 4 µs from end of last received word) before transmitting Status.

fsm_hints_remote_terminal.name: RT_TX_STATUS
fsm_hints_remote_terminal.description: RT transmits Status Word echoing its address + status bits (Message Error / Service Request / Busy / Subsystem Flag / Terminal Flag / etc.). Broadcast (RT address 31): RT SHALL NOT transmit Status.

fsm_hints_remote_terminal.name: RT_TX_DATA
fsm_hints_remote_terminal.description: (transmit-message or mode-with-data-transmit) RT transmits 1..32 Data Words from the addressed subaddress / Vector Word.

fsm_hints_remote_terminal.name: RT_SUPERSEDE
fsm_hints_remote_terminal.description: If during RT's own response a new sync from BC arrives, RT supersedes its own message (BC reassertion).

fsm_hints_bus_monitor.name: BM_IDLE_LISTEN
fsm_hints_bus_monitor.description: Continuously samples both Bus A and Bus B for sync activity; records every Manchester word with its time stamp.

fsm_hints_bus_monitor.name: BM_DECODE
fsm_hints_bus_monitor.description: BM decodes each word into Command / Status / Data based on sync polarity + position in the message; logs to local memory.

fsm_hints_bus_monitor.name: BM_FILTER
fsm_hints_bus_monitor.description: Optional acceptance filter by RT address / subaddress / message type to bound storage.

fsm_hints_bus_monitor.name: BM_NEVER_TX
fsm_hints_bus_monitor.description: BM transmitter SHALL be permanently disabled.

synchronization_rules: Each word starts with a 3 µs SYNC field. Command/Status sync = HIGH 1.5 µs then LOW 1.5 µs. Data sync = LOW 1.5 µs then HIGH 1.5 µs (inverted).
Sync field is NON-Manchester — it cannot occur in the Manchester-coded payload and is unambiguous against bit-cell encoding.
Receivers sample at mid-bit (Manchester mid-bit transition); a missing or wrong-polarity transition is a Manchester encoding error and the word is discarded.
All 1553 nodes share the same 1 Mbit/s bit clock; long-term ±0.1 % accuracy / short-term ±0.01 % stability bounds free-running clock drift across a message.
arbitration_rule: No bitwise arbitration. The Bus Controller is the single transmitter at any given time (master/slave). All bus access is initiated by the BC's Command Word; RTs may only respond when explicitly addressed.
anti_deadlock_rule: BC enforces the 14 µs no-response timeout and retries on the redundant bus. A misbehaving RT cannot lock the bus because (a) RT has no autonomous TX rights and (b) the BC may shut down a specific RT transmitter via the Transmitter Shutdown / Selected Transmitter Shutdown mode codes.
exit_from_reset_or_wakeup: On power-up or after a Reset Remote Terminal mode code (01000), the RT initializes its subaddress descriptor table, clears Status-Word condition bits, performs power-on BIT, and enters RT_IDLE listening for the next Command Word.
default_signal_state_when_bus_free: Bus is quiescent (no Manchester transitions). Inter-message gap ≥ 4 µs of no activity. The bus is differentially terminated at both ends; differential voltage is near zero when idle.
wake_up_message_identifier: Not applicable in the protocol — 1553 has no protocol-level sleep / wake state machine. BC simply resumes transfers when subsystems are ready. Some integrators implement a BC heartbeat (e.g. Transmit Status Word polling) as a wake-up surrogate.
